reviews.text: Great business. Beautiful photos. Great owner. Would definitely recommend this service.

reviews.author: Anne Kristine Maligat-Canete
reviews.text:
We had such a great experience with Captured YXE! ❤️ We had limited space for the setup, but they still made it work perfectly.

The photos turned out really great, and everyone had so much fun taking pictures! Thank you for being part of my mom's 60th birthday and helping us capture such special memories. Highly recommend! 📸💕

reviews.author: Inshal Anees
reviews.text: Had such an awesome experience with Captured! He made all the guests so happy and was super accommodating. Highly recommend if you're looking for an efficient yet decent priced photobooth

reviews.author: Kenneth Canete
reviews.text: We had such a blast with the photo booth last month! The pictures came out super clear, the equipment was sleek, and the whole experience was seamless from start to finish. The team running it was really engaging and made sure everyone had fun. Highly recommend!
